import hashlib


def log_order(order, logger):
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(order.rut.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    logger.info("order=%s rut_fp=%s", order.id, fingerprint)

def public_user(user):
    payload = user.to_dict()
    payload.pop("password_hash", None)
    payload.pop("mfa_secret", None)
    return payload
